Title: Burke-Gilman Trail
Note: 27 paved miles from Ballard through the U District and out to Bothell. The spine of running and cycling here.

Title: Discovery Park
Note: 534 acres above the Sound. The 2.8-mile Loop Trail is the one, and the bluff opens onto the Olympics.

Title: Green Lake Park
Note: The default loop. 2.8 miles, flat, lit at night, and busy enough that running alone never feels like it.

Title: Elliott Bay Trail
Note: Flat waterfront miles from Myrtle Edwards north. Container cranes on one side, ferries on the other.

Title: Washington Park Arboretum
Note: 230 acres of trees with soft paths through them. Go in April for the azaleas.

Title: Interlaken Park
Note: A wooded ravine between Capitol Hill and Montlake. Steep, quiet, and shaded the whole way.

Title: Myrtle Edwards Park
Note: The downtown-adjacent stretch of waterfront path. Where people run on a lunch break.

Title: Seward Park
Note: Loop the peninsula, then cut into the old-growth trails in the middle when you want dirt.
